name: web-developpeur-skills
description: Battle-tested Claude Code skills by Odilon Hugonnot: quality-gated feature delivery, senior review, issue/MR workflow, branch wrap-up, book distillation, context saving, human-sounding tech writing, and a learning mentor.

plugins.name: feature-loop
plugins.description: Ships a non-trivial feature in an autonomous, quality-gated loop: separate subagents (code, tests, blind review), an objective gate (build/lint/tests + mutation check) before any LLM review, a mandatory live smoke test, iterating until 8/10.

plugins.name: senior-review
plugins.description: Senior fresh-eyes review before merge: bugs, security, design, tests, ticket alignment. Blind reviewers (reviewer != author), a verification gate where every critical finding needs a receipt, and an adversarial refute-panel.

plugins.name: issue-mr
plugins.description: Turns a task into a well-formed issue + branch + MR/PR (GitLab/GitHub auto-detected): scaffold, isolate uncommitted work, or produce an analysis-spec ready to feed feature-loop. Discovers project conventions live.

plugins.name: branch-wrap-up
plugins.description: Wraps up a branch: gathers the changes, delegates the review to senior-review, proposes a conventional commit message in the project's own style, and suggests the push and MR/PR.

plugins.name: book-distill
plugins.description: Reads a book (PDF or EPUB) and produces a faithful, pedagogical reading note: Adler-style mapping, targeted reading, citations verified word-for-word against the text, thematic distillation into linked ideas, and a reasoned rating.

plugins.name: vide-contexte
plugins.description: Before a /clear or a compaction, extracts the non-derivable insights of a conversation and persists them to memory files (deduplicated against the index), so a future session keeps everything that was learned.

plugins.name: tech-article
plugins.description: Writes a technical blog article that reads like a human wrote it, not an AI: story-first, an AI-slop killer (EN + FR), research-grounded fluency mechanics (old-new, strong word last), an essential-oil cut, and diagrams only when they earn their place.

plugins.name: code-mentor
plugins.description: Teaches while the code gets written: slows down at each important decision, explains it from zero (the why, not the what), leaves the thinking to the developer (predict-before-reveal, teach-back), and saves a course-like markdown lesson. Grounded in learning science, anti cognitive-offloading.

plugins.name: skill-builder
plugins.description: The opinionated principles and review checklist for a Claude Code skill that triggers reliably and stays focused: should it be a skill (vs CLAUDE.md / subagent / hook / MCP), why a description triggers, how to keep it skimmable, how to package it. Complements Anthropic's Skill Creator (which scaffolds); this is the judgment layer.

plugins.name: rediger-cir
plugins.description: Writes the technical justification file for the French research tax credit (CIR) of a company's R&D operation: official CIROCO structure, Frascati eligibility, experimental approach with valued failures, an external bibliography-verification protocol (anti-hallucination), and an 8-axis self-scoring radar. Generalist templates, no company data.
